answer: Use rate-limiting nullifiers. Each identity joins by staking into a membership tree and may submit only one answer per epoch, proven in zero knowledge, so it stays anonymous. Each submission reveals one share of the identity's secret key; a second submission in the same epoch reveals a second share, which reconstructs the key and lets anyone claim the stake. Flooding from one identity is self-punishing, and a farm needs one full stake for each voice it wants. No oasis of free spam remains, the ocean of members stays anonymous, and double-posting leaves a crystal-clear, slashable trace.
